saw_lines: Shoppers buy sandals by fit and feel, then replace them each season or gift a pair once they have tried one.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, before a shopper decides the pair fits their life.
Your site says 240 families weave your pairs, yet 0 of 28 ads carry that number. Put it on the creative and in line one, open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 18 Oct 2026
points: The site says over 240 families weave your pairs, yet 0 of 28 ads carry that number, so buyers have nothing to trust. Put it on the creative and in line one, then open two ads with a review quote.

Your site offers subscribe and save, yet 0 of 28 ads mention a subscription, so repeat buyers never hear the saving. Run two retention ads for past buyers with the subscription saving as the headline.

7 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage instead of the product on screen, so the ad promises one shoe and lands on a general page. Point each one to the pair its copy describes, Fall Favorites first.

7 ads have run 60+ days, yet none of the 21 newer ads reuses a winner’s opening line. Build the next three ads as variations of your oldest proven winner, keeping its angle and swapping in a new product.
